title: Daily Digest — October 12, 2026 · Technical Edition
subtitle: Levitated entanglement, dynamical gauge fields, topological memory, analog circuits and ESP32 engineering.
editor_note: Six technical investigations with their actual research or project dates: levitated optomechanical entanglement; a hybrid trapped-ion gauge simulator; a new mathematical account of noisy topological phases; silicon reverse engineering from October 11; and two ESP32 engineering projects from r/esp32. Expect experimental methods, numerical context, worked calculations, implementation trade-offs and specific limits, not politics or headlines alone.

paragraphs.text: A nanoparticle is optically trapped inside a cavity. A separate optical field carries its quantum correlations into an external measurement. The experiment operates at room temperature under ultrahigh vacuum.

The researchers find a measured nonseparability parameter below unity. Its statistical and systematic uncertainties are reported separately. It is a quantum correlation result, not a demonstration of a large network.
